title.zh: 主语在“是”前，身份说明在后；“是”前加“不”否定，句末加“吗”提问

explanation.en: Put the subject before 是 and the identity after it. 不 before 是 negates the identity; 吗 at the end asks a yes-or-no question. In a clear identification context a reply may be short, as in 是我 or 不是我.
explanation.zh: 主语在“是”前，身份说明在后；“是”前加“不”否定，句末加“吗”提问。确认人物的情境明确时，可简答“是我、不是我”。

explanation.en: A quality can be a predicate: 很好 means good here, without 是. Put 的 after the owner. When both people know the object, 我的 can stand for mine. 有 says someone has something.

title.zh: 先说人，再说动作，最后说动作涉及的事物

explanation.en: Put the person or people first, then the action, then its object. Recombine independently introduced actions and objects in this order. The verb keeps the same form when the person changes. 和 joins people; 也 goes before the action to mean also.
explanation.zh: 先说人，再说动作，最后说动作涉及的事物。可以按这个顺序重新组合已经学过的动作和事物。人称改变时，动词形式不变。“和”连接人，“也”放在动作前，表示也做这个动作。

title.zh: 所属者在“的”前，被所属的事物在后

explanation.en: Put the possessor before 的 and the possessed thing after it. With a pronoun and a noun naming a close family or personal relationship, 的 is often omitted: 我妈妈 means my mother, and 我朋友 means my friend. This omission does not make 的 unnecessary in every ownership phrase.
explanation.zh: 所属者在“的”前，被所属的事物在后。代词和亲属、朋友等表示亲近人际关系的名词之间常省略“的”，如“我妈妈”“我朋友”；不能因此把所有所属短语中的“的”都删掉。

title.zh: 数词、指示词和名词之间要用合适的量词

explanation.en: Use number + suitable classifier + noun, or demonstrative + suitable classifier + noun. Count with 二 in the number sequence; before an ordinary classifier use 两 for two. Do not replace every 二 with 两.

explanation.en: Put a time expression before the predicate, either before or after the subject. The verb itself does not change for yesterday, today or tomorrow. title.en: Describe a topic and its properties
title.zh: 事物可直接作话题，不必都用“被”

explanation.en: An entity can be the topic of a comment without a passive marker. A subject-predicate phrase can describe a topic or modify a noun; keep its internal subject and predicate together. A noun phrase can predicate a quantity or date without 是, such as a person’s age. This is a bounded pattern, not permission to omit 是 from all identity clauses. An affected entity can also be the subject of a completed-action predicate without a passive marker; this differs from moving an object before an overt agent.
explanation.zh: 事物可直接作话题，不必都用“被”。主谓短语可说明话题，也可修饰名词，短语内部的主谓关系保持不变。表示年龄、日期等的名词短语可不用“是”而直接作谓语，不能据此在所有身份句中省略“是”。受影响的事物也可不用“被”而作完成动作谓语的主语，这与把宾语放到明确施事前面不同。

title.zh: “需要”加动作表示有必要做；“应该”加动作表示对该怎么做的判断

explanation.en: 需要 + action expresses a need. 应该 + action gives a judgment about what should be done. These do not mean that the person has already done it or is necessarily willing to do it. 得 děi and 该 express duty; 愿意 expresses willingness, not ability or obligation. 不愿意 denies willingness. 不需要 denies need, whereas 不该 says an action is inadvisable or wrong.
explanation.zh: “需要”加动作表示有必要做；“应该”加动作表示对该怎么做的判断。这些词不表示动作已经完成，也不保证当事人愿意做。“得”读 děi，“该”表示责任或应当；“愿意”表示意愿，不是能力或义务。“不愿意”否定意愿，“不需要”否定必要性，“不该”表示不应当。

explanation.zh: “一点儿”加“也”或“都”，再加“不”，表示连很小的程度也没有。最少一次的次数短语后加“也／都＋没”，表示连一次都没发生。否定词跟谓语放在一起：这里“不”否定一般状态或意愿，“没”表示具体事件未发生。

title.zh: 把“再也不”放在动作前，说明此后不再发生；句末“了”可表示新决定，不是说以前从未发生

explanation.en: Put the continuing negative before the action to say it will not happen again. The final change particle can mark a new decision; this does not say the action never happened before. 再也没 refers to an absence since a past point; 再也不 can be a future resolve. 怎么也/都 + 不/没 expresses inability despite attempts; 不 and 没 keep their usual non-event/event contrast.
explanation.zh: 把“再也不”放在动作前，说明此后不再发生；句末“了”可表示新决定，不是说以前从未发生。“再也没”回顾某时以来没有发生，“再也不”可表示今后的决心。“怎么也／都＋不／没”表示尝试仍不能，区分一般性否定与具体事件未发生或结果未达到。

explanation.en: Reject the expected development, then state a contrasting actual result. The reversal must connect to the expectation rather than merely add a fact. 不是…吗 introduces an expectation; 还/还是 then marks an outcome contrary to it. 还是 can stress that the expected change did not occur.
explanation.zh: 先否定预期的发展，再说明相反的实际结果；“反而”必须与预期形成联系，不只是补充。“不是……吗”提出预期，后面的“还、还是”说明结果与预期相反；“还是”也可强调原来情况没有改变。

title.zh: “人家”可以指别人或某一群人，有时也指说话者自己

explanation.en: This conversational pronoun can refer to another person or group, or sometimes to the speaker. Identify its referent from context; it can express respect, distance, complaint or an intimate tone. 人家 can be a playful or plaintive self-reference in intimate informal interaction. It is not a neutral substitute for 我 in formal or unfamiliar relationships.
explanation.zh: “人家”可以指别人或某一群人，有时也指说话者自己。根据语境确定所指，并留意尊重、距离、抱怨或亲昵等态度。“人家”在亲近、非正式的交谈中也可带撒娇或委屈语气地自指，不能在正式或陌生关系中当作中性的“我”。

title.en: 就 / 了: X就X or X了就X了 accepts a state or event
title.zh: 在“就”前后重复状态，表示接受这个结果，再否定所担心的后果

explanation.en: Repeat the state around the linking word to accept it, then dismiss the feared consequence. Acceptance of this result does not mean that improvement is unnecessary. This example accepts a state; the related event form adds the completion particle. Repeating a completed event with 了 acknowledges that it has happened and treats it as something to accept or set aside.
explanation.zh: 在“就”前后重复状态，表示接受这个结果，再否定所担心的后果。接受这次结果不等于以后不用改进。这里是状态式；接受已发生事件的相关形式还带“了”。重复已发生事件时保留“了”，承认事情已经发生，表示接受或不再计较。
